newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to set sugar production levy Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: EU to set sugar production levy Wednesday.

text.p: The first instalment of the European Union's 1996/97 (July/June) sugar production levy is expected to be set unchanged from last year on Wednesday, an EU member state official said on Monday.
Last year the first instalment levies were 0.632 ecus per 100 kg for "A" quota sugar and 11.848 ecus per 100 kg for "B" quota.
The inulin syrup "A" quota levy was 0.632 ecus per 100 kg and its "B" quota was 11.848 ecus per 100 kg.
The first isoglucose levy was 0.506 ecus per 100 kg.
The levy, paid by sugar processors and producers is used to finance the cost of subsidised exports to non-EU countries.
Member state officials say that the levy will remain at last year's level because the intervention price for sugar remains the same. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
